descriptions.primary: Special Products & Mfg., Inc. (SPM) is a contract manufacturing company providing medium and large growing OEM's with manufacturing services and solutions. We specialize in electro-mechanical assembly, precision metal fabrication, machining, welding, and powder coating. We provide our customers in various industries with a variety of products. From our humble beginnings in a garage shop we grew and moved into larger facilities in Dallas, Garland, and lastly into our current home in Rockwall, Texas. We currently operate in a state-of-the-art 140,000 square foot facility in the prominent Rockwall Technology Park. Our Mission:To consistently deliver innovative and efficient contract manufacturing solutions that provide our customers with a competitive advantage. Our Vision: To be recognized as an innovator of world class manufacturing processes, people development and contract manufacturing solutions that provide a competitive edge for our customers globally. descriptions.primary: Washington Metalworks are a large specialist metalwork company established in 1985, based in the North of England offering a wide variety of services. Located in our own 150,000 square foot premises, Washington Metalworks are proud of its Manusoft manufacturing resource planning software, which gives comprehensive control from enquiry stage through to delivery. This provides real time scheduling and offers a real commercial advantage, demonstrating our commitment to continuous investment in both plant and people. Our state of the art CNC controlled machinery allows us to design, fabricate, finish and final assemble a wide variety of product in the swiftest possible time and give customers an option to a flexible fast track service option for those times when your production requirements are urgent. We manage our own transport fleet (with full Road Angel Vehicle Tracking Capability) which enables us to react precisely to our customers needs. We have recently installed a million pound paint plant on site where we are able to meet stringent standards.

Areco is a privately owned Swedish company founded in 1944 and today is one of the leading players in the sheet metal industry. Areco's business activities are mainly directed to the construction industry with a comprehensive range of building components in sheet metal for residential and commercial properties. Areco Steel is the parent company of the privately-owned Areco Group, which also includes the five divisions: Areco Metals, Areco Profiles, Areco Direct, Areco Contractor and Areco Properties with a total of 162 employees in Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Poland. Customers are served in 25 countries.

descriptions.primary: MacDonald Steel, founded in 1957, is a custom steel fabrication and machining plant. Our facility sits on 20 acres of land and the plant floor consists of 190 000 sq ft of fabrication space. MacDonald Steel includes three divisions; Custom Fabricating, Environmental Systems Division and Specialty Products. The custom fabrication side of our business manufactures products to our customers' drawings and specifications. We manufacture parts weighing only a few pounds to items that require special permitting to ship due to size or weight. Our facility provides one stop shopping for our customers. Environmental Systems division designs, manufactures, installs and services our own dust collectors (Shaker, Reverse Air, Pulse), Cyclones, Rotary Air Locks, Fans, Spark Systems and Bin Covers. Our 50 years of experience is leveraged to offer our customers an exceptional line of products to suit their application. The Specialty Products division combines the disciplines of design, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of brew-on-the premise systems and equipment. Our brew-on premise equipment packages are built to the highest standard in the industry. MacDonald Steel personnel and welding procedures are certified to CSA W47.1 in the fusion welding of steel products. We have earned American Society for Mechanical Engineers Certification as well as Ontario Technical Standards and Safety Act certification in pressure vessel manufacturing and repairs.

descriptions.primary: Prince offers the most comprehensive selection of welding services in the Middle Georgia area. Our competent staff of qualified weldors are trained in the proper joining of aluminum, stainless steel, carbon steel, cast iron, and alloys. We regularly shear and form carbon steel, galvanized steel, aluminum, stainless steel, copper, and other alloys in sheet and plate form. Our rolling equipment has the capacity to roll plate, sheet metal, I-beams, angle iron, channel iron, and bar stock. We manufacture spiral pipe including galvanized steel, aluminum, and stainless steel. Prince Service & Mfg, Inc provides custom fabrication of nearly any metal products. Carbon steel, aluminum, stainless steel, copper, from light gauge sheet - to 1' plate. Our punching equipment allows for countless variations and styles of punched configurations including, circles, rectangular, squares, and even countersunk. It was February 1965 when Joe Prince, after a long career in the sheet metal trade, realized that the Middle Georgia 'Industrial Marketplace' was in need of a contractor that could provide superior quality fabricated metal parts and mechanical millwright services. As Middle Georgia grew, so did Prince Sheet Metal Works. With the addition of state of the art production facilities, Prince Sheet Metal expanded its manufacturing capabilities to meet the specific needs of its growing customer base.
descriptions.website: With a focus on building strong relationships, Prince strives to go the extra mile to ensure that our partners have every opportunity for success in their projects.

descriptions.primary: Total Manufacturing CompanyEstablished 1974 in Lincoln, Nebraska, where it still operates today, Total Manufacturing Company specializes in one-stop, concept-to-completion metal manufacturing services. TMCO can finish a product from any stage be it design, fabrication, paint, assembly-or if you wish, the whole ball of wax. Whether a small quantity or a huge manufacturing run, TMCO treats all of its customers with the same reverence. "We hope that we exceed our clients' expectations every time," says owner and founder, Roland Temme. In addition Temme says, "It's a partnership deal because we're looking to build long-term customer relationships."That partnership could have a major impact on your design. Just ask Tim Thomssen about a little project that came across his desk several years back. The concept was one farmer's idea for a useful machine. That machine was a forced air unit used to dry wet cows-essentially a cow dryer (this is Nebraska, folks). Lo and behold through their combined teamwork a design was born and production began on a truly unique item. Not only did TMCO make it possible, they streamlined manufacturing to the fewest steps saving their customer substantial money and time. That product proved so successful, to this day some 10,000 units have been manufactured and shipped from TMCO. That story isn't unusual in a shop that cultivates the greatest potential from their staff. When you hire the best people, give them the best machines, it's almost impossible to fail. The proof is in the pudding. Since its inception TMCO has quadrupled in size and will most likely double in the next five years. Couple that with its low turnover and high employee loyalty and it's no wonder TMCO is flourishing today. Take the tour and learn for yourself why in the age of outsourcing and impersonal service, TMCO holds on tight to the values that have made it a powerhouse in the metal fabrication business.
descriptions.website: TMCO excels in Lincoln's large-scale manufacturing, welding, and powder coating. Visit our home page for quality and personalized service.
